query.sql: WITH RECURSIVE t(at) AS (SELECT ($from / $step) * $step UNION ALL SELECT at + $step FROM t WHERE at + $step < $to), c AS (SELECT (started / $step) * $step AS at, COUNT(*) AS n FROM runs WHERE started >= $from AND started < $to AND ($agent = '' OR agent = $agent) GROUP BY 1) SELECT t.at AS time, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS runs FROM t LEFT JOIN c USING (at) ORDER BY t.at

WITH RECURSIVE t(at) AS (SELECT ($from / $step) * $step UNION ALL SELECT at + $step FROM t WHERE at + $step < $to), c AS (SELECT (created / $step) * $step AS at, COUNT(*) AS n FROM messages WHERE created >= $from AND created < $to AND ($agent = '' OR agent = $agent) GROUP BY 1) SELECT t.at AS time, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS messages FROM t LEFT JOIN c USING (at) ORDER BY t.at

WITH RECURSIVE t(at) AS (SELECT ($from / $step) * $step UNION ALL SELECT at + $step FROM t WHERE at + $step < $to), c AS (SELECT (updated / $step) * $step AS at, COUNT(*) AS n FROM checklist_items WHERE updated >= $from AND updated < $to AND ($agent = '' OR agent = $agent) AND status = 'done' GROUP BY 1) SELECT t.at AS time, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS done FROM t LEFT JOIN c USING (at) ORDER BY t.at

WITH RECURSIVE t(at) AS (SELECT ($from / $step) * $step UNION ALL SELECT at + $step FROM t WHERE at + $step < $to), c AS (SELECT MAX(((hour * 1000) / $step) * $step, ($from / $step) * $step) AS at, SUM(input + output) AS n FROM agent_usage WHERE hour >= $from_s - 3599 AND hour < $to_s AND ($agent = '' OR agent = $agent) GROUP BY 1) SELECT t.at AS time, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS tokens FROM t LEFT JOIN c USING (at) ORDER BY t.at

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', (hour / MAX($step_s, 3600)) * MAX($step_s, 3600), 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS time, agent, SUM(input + output) AS tokens FROM agent_usage WHERE hour >= $from_s - 3599 AND hour < $to_s AND agent != '' AND agent NOT LIKE 'chat:%' AND ($agent = '' OR agent = $agent) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', (started / $step) * $step / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS time, agent, COUNT(*) AS runs FROM runs WHERE started >= $from AND started < $to AND agent != '' AND agent NOT LIKE 'chat:%' AND ($agent = '' OR agent = $agent) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT agent, task, started FROM tasks WHERE ended IS NULL AND ($agent = '' OR agent = $agent) ORDER BY started DESC
SELECT agent, MAX(agent_name) AS name FROM agent_usage WHERE hour >= $from_s - 3600 AND agent != '' AND agent NOT LIKE 'chat:%' GROUP BY agent ORDER BY name
